source.name: v_sales_opp_overview
source.view:
SELECT o.id,
    o.status,
    o.closed_reason,
    t.code AS type_code,
    t.name AS type_name,
    o.stage,
    o.probability,
    o.priority_score,
    o.customer_id,
    cu.name AS customer_name,
    cu.phone AS customer_phone,
    o.owner_org_staff_id,
    st.name AS owner_name,
    o.anchor_date,
    o.trial_start_date,
    (o.lifecycle_end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date AS het_vong_doi,
    (o.lifecycle_end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date - fn_opp_today_vn() AS con_lai_ngay,
    o.source_kind,
    o.source_crm_id,
    o.care_progress,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM aka_crm c
          WHERE c.sales_opportunity_id = o.id AND c.source_type = 'sales_opp'::text) AS so_task_buoc,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM aka_crm c
          WHERE c.sales_opportunity_id = o.id AND c.source_type = 'sales_opp'::text AND c.cskh_completed_date IS NOT NULL) AS so_task_da_lam,
    o.next_action_type,
    o.next_action_at,
    o.actual_revenue,
    o.created_at,
    o.closed_at
   FROM aka_salesopportunity o
     JOIN aka_salesopportunity_type t ON t.id = o.type_id
     JOIN aka_customer cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id
     LEFT JOIN org_staff st ON st.id = o.owner_org_staff_id;

source.name: v_sales_opp_task_hom_nay
source.view:
SELECT c.id AS crm_id,
    c.sales_opportunity_id AS opp_id,
    c.gen_meta ->> 'type_code'::text AS type_code,
    c.gen_meta ->> 'step_code'::text AS step_code,
    c.gen_meta ->> 'actor'::text AS actor,
    (c.gen_meta ->> 'manual_send'::text)::boolean AS nv_gui_tay,
    c.gen_meta ->> 'segment'::text AS segment,
    c.gen_meta ->> 'state'::text AS trial_state,
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    c.customer_phone,
    c.org_staff_owner_id,
    st.name AS owner_name,
    c.suggested_channel_id,
    c.priority,
    (c.cskh_due_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text) AS han_vn,
    c.gen_status,
    c.cskh_completed_date,
    c.suggested_content,
    c.task_note,
    c.pancake_url
   FROM aka_crm c
     LEFT JOIN org_staff st ON st.id = c.org_staff_owner_id
  WHERE c.source_type = 'sales_opp'::text AND (c.cskh_due_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date = fn_opp_today_vn();

source.name: v_trial_cham_14ngay
source.view:
WITH trial_raw AS (
         SELECT o.customer_id,
            o.date_create AS trial_at,
            'old'::text AS he_thong,
            o.id AS ref_id,
            o.account_id_old,
            NULL::bigint AS organization_id,
            o.product_list AS san_pham_goc,
            o.username AS tai_khoan,
                CASE
                    WHEN o.product_list ~~* '%sms%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%zalo%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%facebook%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%fb%'::text THEN 'SMS'::text
                    WHEN o.product_list ~~* '%zalo%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%facebook%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%fb%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%fanpage%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%sms%'::text THEN 'Zalo'::text
                    WHEN (o.product_list ~~* '%facebook%'::text OR o.product_list ~~* '%fbextension%'::text OR o.product_list ~~* '%fanpage%'::text) AND o.product_list !~~* '%zalo%'::text AND o.product_list !~~* '%sms%'::text THEN 'Facebook'::text
                    ELSE 'Combo'::text
                END AS nhom
           FROM aka_order o
          WHERE o.package = 'demo'::text AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND o.date_create >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date - 15)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT g.customer_id,
            q.created_at,
            'new'::text,
            q.id,
            NULL::integer,
            q.organization_id,
            q.product_name,
            g.sql_account_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN q.product_name ~~* '%facebook%'::text OR q.product_name ~~* '%fanpage%'::text THEN 'Facebook'::text
                    WHEN q.product_name ~~* '%zalo%'::text THEN 'Zalo'::text
                    WHEN q.product_name ~~* '%sms%'::text THEN 'SMS'::text
                    ELSE 'Combo'::text
                END AS "case"
           FROM org_organization_product q
             JOIN org_organization g ON g.id = q.organization_id
          WHERE q.package_type = 'demo'::text AND COALESCE(q.is_deleted, false) = false AND NOT COALESCE(q.is_paid, false) AND g.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND q.created_at >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date - 15)
        ), trial AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (trial_raw.customer_id, trial_raw.nhom) trial_raw.customer_id,
            trial_raw.trial_at,
            trial_raw.he_thong,
            trial_raw.ref_id,
            trial_raw.account_id_old,
            trial_raw.organization_id,
            trial_raw.san_pham_goc,
            trial_raw.tai_khoan,
            trial_raw.nhom
           FROM trial_raw
          ORDER BY trial_raw.customer_id, trial_raw.nhom, trial_raw.trial_at
        ), base AS (
         SELECT t.customer_id,
            t.trial_at,
            t.he_thong,
            t.ref_id,
            t.account_id_old,
            t.organization_id,
            t.san_pham_goc,
            t.tai_khoan,
            t.nhom,
            a.name AS ten_khach,
            a.phone,
            NULLIF(a.email, ''::text) AS email,
            a.org_staff_id_owner,
            a.inbox_url,
            a.linh_vuc,
            (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date - (t.trial_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text)::date AS ngay_thu,
            fn_trang_thai_mua(t.customer_id) AS trang_thai_mua,
            (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM aka_sale_order s
                     JOIN aka_sale_order_item i ON i.sale_order_id = s.id
                  WHERE s.customer_id = t.customer_id AND s.status = 'completed'::text AND s.paid_at >= (t.trial_at - '01:00:00'::interval))) AS da_co_don,
            a.decline_date IS NOT NULL AND a.decline_date >= t.trial_at AS da_tu_choi,
                CASE
                    WHEN t.he_thong = 'old'::text THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM aka_tracking_app k
                      WHERE k.account_id = t.account_id_old AND (k.event_type = ANY (ARRAY['login'::text, 'login_app_akabiz'::text, 'open_app_akabiz'::text]))))
                    ELSE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM auto_accounts x
                      WHERE x.organization_id = t.organization_id AND COALESCE(x.is_delete, false) = false))
                END AS da_dang_nhap,
                CASE
                    WHEN t.he_thong = 'old'::text THEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM aka_tracking_app k
                      WHERE k.account_id = t.account_id_old AND k.event_type = 'add'::text))
                    ELSE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM auto_campaigns k
                      WHERE k.organization_id = t.organization_id AND k.created_at >= (t.trial_at - '01:00:00'::interval)))
                END AS da_chay_chien_dich,
                CASE
                    WHEN t.he_thong = 'old'::text THEN ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                       FROM aka_tracking_app k
                      WHERE k.account_id = t.account_id_old AND k.event_type = 'add'::text)
                    ELSE ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                       FROM auto_campaigns k
                      WHERE k.organization_id = t.organization_id AND k.created_at >= (t.trial_at - '01:00:00'::interval))
                END AS so_chien_dich,
            ( SELECT max(g.question_first_at) AS max
                   FROM message_gom g
                  WHERE g.aka_customer_id = t.customer_id AND g.initiated_by = 'CUSTOMER'::text AND COALESCE(g.question_content, ''::text) <> ''::text) AS tin_khach_cuoi
           FROM trial t
             JOIN aka_customer a ON a.id = t.customer_id
        )
 SELECT customer_id,
    ten_khach,
    phone,
    email,
    nhom,
    he_thong,
    ref_id,
    organization_id,
    tai_khoan,
    san_pham_goc,
    trial_at,
    ngay_thu,
        CASE
            WHEN ngay_thu = ANY (ARRAY[1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 14]) THEN ngay_thu
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS moc,
        CASE
            WHEN da_chay_chien_dich THEN 'A'::text
            WHEN da_dang_nhap THEN 'B'::text
            ELSE 'C'::text
        END AS nhanh,
    trang_thai_mua,
    da_co_don,
    da_tu_choi,
    da_dang_nhap,
    da_chay_chien_dich,
    so_chien_dich,
    tin_khach_cuoi,
    trang_thai_mua <> 'dang_dung'::text AND NOT da_co_don AND NOT da_tu_choi AS du_dieu_kien,
    tin_khach_cuoi IS NULL OR tin_khach_cuoi < (now() - '48:00:00'::interval) AS khach_im_lang_48h,
    ngay_thu >= 5 AND (tin_khach_cuoi IS NULL OR tin_khach_cuoi < (now() - '48:00:00'::interval)) AS gui_tu_dong,
    org_staff_id_owner,
    inbox_url,
    linh_vuc
   FROM base;

constraints.name: auto_account_contact_groups_dataset_sync_mode_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((dataset_sync_mode = 'manual'::text) AND (dataset_sync_key IS NULL)) OR ((dataset_sync_mode = 'dataset_auto'::text) AND (dataset_sync_key IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: auto_accounts_zalo_phone_check_usage_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((zalo_phone_check_usage IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(zalo_phone_check_usage) = 'object'::text) AND (zalo_phone_check_usage ?& ARRAY['date'::text, 'count'::text]) AND (((zalo_phone_check_usage - 'date'::text) - 'count'::text) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((zalo_phone_check_usage -> 'date'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((zalo_phone_check_usage ->> 'date'::text) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'::text) AND ((((zalo_phone_check_usage ->> 'date'::text))::date)::text = (zalo_phone_check_usage ->> 'date'::text)) AND (jsonb_typeof((zalo_phone_check_usage -> 'count'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND ((zalo_phone_check_usage ->> 'count'::text) ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,9})$'::text) AND (((zalo_phone_check_usage ->> 'count'::text))::numeric <= (2147483647)::numeric))))

constraints.name: auto_campaign_input_data_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['chờ xử lý'::text, 'tạm dừng'::text, 'đang chạy'::text, 'hoàn thành'::text])))

constraints.name: auto_campaign_inputs_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['chờ xử lý'::text, 'tạm dừng'::text, 'đang chạy'::text, 'hoàn thành'::text, 'lỗi'::text])))

constraints.name: auto_campaigns_secondary_account_diff_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((secondary_account_id IS NULL) OR (secondary_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM account_id)))

constraints.name: auto_content_templates_secondary_group_ids_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((cardinality(secondary_group_ids) <= 100) AND (array_position(secondary_group_ids, NULL::bigint) IS NULL) AND (0 < ALL (secondary_group_ids)) AND private.bigint_array_has_unique_elements(secondary_group_ids) AND ((cardinality(secondary_group_ids) = 0) OR (group_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ((group_id IS NULL) OR (NOT (group_id = ANY (secondary_group_ids))))))

constraints.name: auto_error_days_at_time_config_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((disable_action_mode <> 'days_at_time'::text) OR ((disable_action_days IS NOT NULL) AND (time_disable_actions IS NOT NULL) AND (time_disable_actions > 0) AND ((disable_action_days > 0) OR (disable_action_time IS NOT NULL)))))

constraints.name: auto_error_detail_override_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((detail_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'override'::text) OR (detail_status_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: auto_error_disable_action_time_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((disable_action_time IS NULL) OR (disable_action_time < '24:00:00'::time without time zone)))

constraints.name: chk_org_product_zalo_server_product16_18
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT COALESCE(is_zalo_server, false)) OR COALESCE((product_id = ANY (ARRAY[(16)::bigint, (18)::bigint])), false)))

constraints.name: chk_org_product_zalo_show_web_product16_18
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT COALESCE(is_zalo_show_web, false)) OR COALESCE((product_id = ANY (ARRAY[(16)::bigint, (18)::bigint])), false)))
